Restores a bit of health.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Ironshrooms are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are made when [[Ironshroom]]s are burned using a [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The exterior of Toasty Ironshrooms is noted to be crunchy. Eating one will restore three-quarters of one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Ironshrooms reappear in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by dropping [[Ironshroom]]s near [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]]. Instead of being tough like a regular Ironshroom, the exterior of Toasty Ironshrooms are known to be crunchy and tasty. If Link eats one, he will restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Ironshroom * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
